name: The Shared Table
summary: A recipe identity that pairs welcoming food writing with a repeatable structure for ingredients, preparation and serving.

recognitionRules: Use Rockwell recipe headings with Noto Sans instructions.
Keep ingredients separate from the ordered method.
Make yield and practical preparation notes easy to find.
Use generous white space so the page can be consulted while cooking.
Use rust collection labels and green recipe links, with black recipe headings and roomy ingredient/method areas.

principles: Make the invitation warm and the practical details exact.
Use the identity’s sample as a rhythm and vocabulary reference, not as a factual project claim.
voice.sample: Something bright for the table. A method you can follow as you cook.
voice.sampleStatus: Original fictional brand copy authored for this guide, not a quotation or factual claim.
avoid: Avoid speaking for an entire community or implying confirmed attendance.
Avoid invented testimonials, performance claims and quotation attribution.
voice.secondaryExample: Come for the part that interests you; here is what to expect.
voice.cadence: Short opening, concrete follow-through; vary sentence length for explanation.

logoDirection: Use THE SHARED TABLE in Rockwell with a broad short underline. No fork-and-spoon crest.
invariants: Use Rockwell recipe headings with Noto Sans instructions.
Keep ingredients separate from the ordered method.
Make yield and practical preparation notes easy to find.
adaptations: A recipe card retains yield, ingredients and complete method.
A collection opener may add a short food story without interrupting the recipe structure.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.

fonts.sourceFontDependency: Rockwell is a separately licensed/system font; not bundled.

clearSpaceRule: Keep one half of the main wordmark cap height clear around the full silhouette, including its source-derived supporting device.

minimumSize.status: production minimum based on rendered 220/180px wordmark and 32/64px symbol inspection; verify again for unusual substrates
